text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle injures herself during<n>training, so I
rush her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Now, don't you fret, Trainer!

The doctor said I was healthy as a<n>mule! It's back
to training startin'<n>tomorrow!

And the timing couldn't be better! I'm<n>just happy I
get to snuggle up in bed<n>for a spell!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
My friend lent me this comic, and it's<n>a real
knee-slapper...
Whoops! Forget you heard that!
choice_data_list: Make sure you get some good rest.

text_block_list.text: Okay! I promise to be out like a light!
Hehe... So where did I leave off...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: ...What?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Nooo! I forgot the comic back at the<n>dorm!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Can you do me a little favor<n>and go get it
for me? I need it now<n>more than ever!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Nooooo!

Trainers are prohibited from entering<n>the dorm
rooms, so it's not like I<n>could help anyway... I make
sure<n>she's well rested by day's end.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Aww, shucks! I really wanted to read<n>it...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So what am I supposed to do?!<n>There's nothing in
here!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Gosh... You're awful strict, Trainer.

While the diagnosis suggests there's<n>nothing
seriously wrong with Taiki,<n>she's not in great
spirits.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
All right, I get it... I know you're just<n>worried about
me.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Okay! If I can't read any comics, I'll<n>just pass the
time with a good movie!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You're killin' me here, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Taiki Shuttle is back to<n>normal and
ready to resume training.
